CalloutConfig.DispatchText: House fire - a resident got out but breathed in smoke. They need help.
CalloutConfig.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. House fire nearby, a resident is out but has breathed smoke. Please respond.
CalloutConfig.EnRouteHelpText: Drive to the yellow marker, then get out and walk up to the resident.
CalloutConfig.OnSceneText: You're on scene. Check on the resident.
CalloutConfig.OnSceneVoiceLine: On scene. Checking on the resident now.

OnSceneTextVariants.string: You made it through the smoke. Let's check on them.
There they are, safe outside. Time to check on them.
On scene - let's help them breathe easier.

CalloutConfig.AssessmentHelpText: Press E (or X on controller) to help the resident.
CalloutConfig.ConversationHelpText: Press E (or X on controller) to talk to the resident.
CalloutConfig.TreatingText: Giving oxygen and helping them breathe...

TreatingTextVariants.string: Getting them some fresh air and oxygen...
Helping clear the smoke from their lungs...
Giving them oxygen and calming them down...

PatientThanksTextVariants.string: Thanks for getting me out safe!
I can breathe so much better now, thank you!
You saved the day, thank you!

CalloutConfig.ResolutionVoiceLine: Nice work. The resident is breathing easier now.

Injury.DispatchText: House fire - a resident is coughing from a little smoke.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. House fire nearby, a resident is coughing from smoke. Please respond.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Resident
DialogueLine.Text: I breathed a little smoke, just a bit of a cough.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: Here's some oxygen - take slow breaths, you're safe now.

Injury.TreatedText: All better! A little oxygen and the cough has settled.

Injury.DispatchText: House fire - a resident is dizzy from breathing smoke.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. House fire nearby, a resident is dizzy from smoke. Please respond.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Resident
DialogueLine.Text: I feel dizzy... I breathed in a lot of smoke.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: Sit down here, breathe the oxygen with me - in and out.

Injury.TreatedText: Nice work - oxygen given and the resident feels much better.

Injury.DispatchText: House fire - a resident has bad smoke inhalation and needs the hospital.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. House fire nearby, a resident has bad smoke inhalation. Please respond quickly.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: Stay calm, oxygen's on - the ambulance is taking you to hospital.

Injury.TransportedText: Great job! The resident is taken to the hospital and will be okay.
